teaser: Our workflow on Odoo 20, built in 98 seconds: a keyless agent, a policy check, a signed approval, a narrow broker and a grant measured from Odoo.
core_idea: An agent with no Odoo credential, a policy check, a signed approval and a narrow broker make Odoo safe to automate; measuring the grant from Odoo shows where the remaining excess lives.

nodes.label: A keyless agent
nodes.summary: It writes plans; it cannot change Odoo.

nodes.label: A narrow broker
nodes.summary: Applies only signed operations, as a narrow user.

nodes.label: The default role's excess
nodes.summary: Email the supplier, read bank accounts, edit drafts.

nodes.label: abp_grant
nodes.summary: Measures a user's grant from Odoo.

nodes.label: Odoo's own agents
nodes.summary: Enterprise-only; automatic triggers write without approval.

quotes.text: It holds no Odoo credential, so it cannot change anything in Odoo, whatever it is told.
On a production instance, that is a send to the world with no barrier at all.

figures.caption: Our workflow on Odoo 20: the agent never touches Odoo; a check, an approval and a broker stand between.
Five proposals, four verdicts: two drafts allowed and applied, a new supplier refused, one held, one escalated.
The grant measured from Odoo: the mandate, what Odoo refuses, and the excess its default user role allows.
